description: This file defines a structure for representing the state of Talk Mode Gateway configuration and provides a parser that extracts configuration details from a dictionary (likely JSON). The parser consolidates various configuration options such as provider, voice ID, voice aliases, model ID, output format, API key, and speech interruption settings into a TalkModeGatewayConfigState object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a configuration dictionary to produce a TalkModeGatewayConfigState object, resolving provider settings, voice aliases, model IDs, output format, API key, and other options based on provided defaults and the contents of the dictionary.
